dct_description_sm:
Includes where particular Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR) land use planning initiatives have effect that have been approved or are established for a significant geographic area. Examples include the Far North Plan Area, Ontario's Living Legacy (OLL) Land Use Strategy, Temagami Land Use Plan Area, Madawaska Highlands Area.

Additional Time Period Information: Date all boundaries were assembled into one digital layer. Currency may vary on actual creation date for individual Land Use Plan boundaries
